newsitem.title: USA: US cash prods enjoy NYMEX bounce, but diffs mixed.
newsitem.headline: US cash prods enjoy NYMEX bounce, but diffs mixed.

text.p: U.S. spot oil prices enjoyed sharp gains by late Friday tracking NYMEX futures, but differentials were mixed in thin trade as many East Coast players remained away for an industry function.
New York Harbor traders said more-than-ample imports of conventional unleaded M4-grade gasoline weakened prompt differentials about 0.25 cent to offers of about 1.50 cent below November futures.
Players agreed a buyers market was shaping up, with sellers trying to unload between 150,000 and 400,000 import barrels.

But Gulf Coast conventional unleaded saw a firming trend amid fall turnarounds and confirmation that Star Enterprise would shut a 15,000 barrel per day hydrocracker Saturday at its 235,000 barrel per day refinery in Port Arthur, Texas, for an unplanned repair.

Star also said it would shut down one of two crude units at its refinery in Convent, La., beginning about Nov 1, for a 20-day repair. "We were going to do it early next year but pushed it up a few months," a refinery spokesman said.
